name: rolodex
description: Open-source relationship rolodex you run locally as a standalone app: own your contacts (SQLite), sync with Google Contacts, and search/log through a real UI. MCP is a secondary integration surface, letting your AI agents read, search, and update the same rolodex.

scripts.shell:build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/shell/index.html dist/shell/index.html && cp src/shell/wizard.html dist/shell/wizard.html && mkdir -p dist/shell/assets && cp src/shell/assets/favicon.svg dist/shell/assets/favicon.svg
